note: Parcel services per county, and statewide where one exists. A county entry wins over the statewide one. Seeded from tbdi-pasa county-services.json (reviewed entries only). Nothing is auto-registered: discover_parcel_service.py writes a proposal, a person reviews it and adds it here. fields maps our roles to that service's column names.

service.name: Arkansas Parcel Polygons (CAMP)
service.owner: Arkansas GIS Office (Arkansas Cadastral Mapping Program)
service.notes: Reviewed 2026-09-22 on the evidence in data/reference/parcel-proposals/remaining-probe.csv (prior-art research, scripts/bulk/BACKLOG.md "Parcel prior-art research"); registration approved by Tucker 2026-09-22 (approach A). All 75 counties, 2,117,780 parcels, published 2026-04-01 (pubdate). Hosted on the state's own server, not AGOL - which is why the statewide sweep missed it. Probe: 6 of 8 unresolved Windstream AR sites returned a polygon, 5 with an operator owner (KINETIC ABS AR, APW ARCCO WS, WHITE RIVER TELEPHONE). Crossett: the pin is in the street; the CSL Arkansas parcel at the site address is ~60 m away. Dalark returned a private owner and Fordyce nothing - both need a person. Vintage per parcel is camadate (the county CAMA extract date). No acreage field; acreage comes from the geometry. A county entry, if registered, wins.

service.name: FDOR Cadastral 2025 (Florida Statewide Parcels)
service.notes: 10,831,924 records covering all Florida counties, published by the state GIO from Department of Revenue cadastral data; service data last edited 2026-09-16. Probed 2026-09-22 at ALCHFL01 (Alachua Co): one polygon, OWN_NAME "CSL FLORIDA SYSTEM LLC", PHY_ADDR1 "13715 W STATE RD 235". No acreage field (Shape__Area only), so acreage comes from the geometry. A county-level entry, if registered, wins.

service.name: Iowa Statewide Parcels, 2017 snapshot
service.owner: University of Iowa (hosted); source Iowa counties
service.notes: 2,450,589 parcels, layer named Parcels_20171102 - a 2017 snapshot, re-hosted on a university account; the service itself was last edited 2024-05-10 but the DATA is 2017. The only statewide Iowa parcel layer that exists: confirmed 2026-09-22 by three independent searches (AGOL item search, ArcGIS Hub dataset index, Iowa DOT and Iowa AGOL org enumeration). Registered deliberately with data_vintage 2017-11-02, which every value carries. BOUNDARIES: fine for screening - parcels rarely move, and a split since 2017 would show as an over-large acreage, not a wrong location. DEEDHOLDER: nine years stale and known wrong for this portfolio - the Windstream/Kinetic parcels transferred through CSL entities in late 2025 (Aug 2026 county-record work). Treat owner from this layer as a 2017 fact, never as current ownership. PARCELCLAS carries the use class (COMMERCIAL / EXEMPT / ...). No acreage field; acreage comes from the geometry.

service.name: Ohio Statewide Parcels
service.notes: 6,313,610 records covering all Ohio counties from one service. Used and verified by the Aug 2026 Windstream parcel work (19 sites across 8 counties); re-probed 2026-09-22, 12/12 Ohio Windstream sites returned exactly one polygon. LocalParcelID is the county parcel number (StateParcelID also present). NO owner field - Ohio's aggregation omits owner names; use the county auditor link in CAMADataSite. LandArea is empty across the service (0 non-zero in a 400-row sample), so acreage comes from the geometry. SitusAddressAll is sparse. A county-level entry, if one is ever registered, wins over this.

service.name: OKMaps Statewide Parcels (Oklahoma Office of Geographic Information)
service.owner: Oklahoma OGI / OKMaps; compiled by Property Records Preservation, LLC from county assessor rolls
service.notes: Reviewed 2026-09-22 on the evidence in data/reference/parcel-proposals/remaining-probe.csv (prior-art research, scripts/bulk/BACKLOG.md "Parcel prior-art research"); registration approved by Tucker 2026-09-22 (approach A). All 77 counties. Published as a GeoServer WMS only: metadata says "view only or through OGC WMS... not available for download". The producer makes one GetFeatureInfo request per site (JSON, EPSG:4326, street-level bbox) and caches it - never a harvest. Probe: 10 of 10 unresolved Windstream OK sites returned a MultiPolygon with an operator owner (CSL OKLAHOMA SYSTEM, KINETIC ABS OK, OKLAHOMA ALLIED TELEPHONE). Vintage per parcel is dataupdate (county roll date, Feb-Aug 2026 for most; Tulsa 2024-07). acres is null throughout; acreage comes from the geometry. Tulsa County (40143, INCOG) keeps its county entry, which wins over this. The same server lists ogi_secure:* layers - not used.

service.name: TxGIO StratMap Land Parcels (most recent)
service.owner: Texas Geographic Information Office (TxGIO, formerly TNRIS)
service.notes: Reviewed 2026-09-22 on the evidence in data/reference/parcel-proposals/remaining-probe.csv (prior-art research, scripts/bulk/BACKLOG.md "Parcel prior-art research"); registration approved by Tucker 2026-09-22 (approach A). Statewide compilation of appraisal-district parcels, 253 of 254 counties in the 2025 collection, CC0. /query is disabled on this MapServer ("operation not supported"), so the producer uses /identify. Probe: 19 of 20 unresolved Windstream TX sites returned a polygon, 17 with OWNER_NAME CSL TEXAS SYSTEM / VALOR TELECOMMUNICATIONS. Moore County polygons carry no attributes (PROP_ID 0); Waterwood (Huntsville) returned nothing. Vintage per parcel is DATE_ACQ (the date TxGIO acquired that county's data). LEGAL_AREA is not mapped to acres because its unit (LGL_AREA_UNIT) varies by county; acreage comes from the geometry. Per-county CAD downloads and earlier years are on the TxGIO DataHub (api.tnris.org). A county entry, if registered, wins. 21 counties are excluded (see exclude): TxGIO releases them only to Texas government entities, so a site there stays unresolved until the county CAD's own service is registered. That affects 3 Windstream sites today (Castro, Dawson, Kerr). Donley is also absent from the service.

service.name: Virginia Statewide Parcels (VGIN / VDEM)
service.notes: Covers all 133 Virginia localities from one service, which is why it is statewide rather than per-county. Carries no address field: an address-to-parcel match is one geocode landing in one polygon and must be confirmed against the assessor. A county-level entry, if one is ever registered, wins over this.

08001.review_notes: Discovery verified nine candidate layers against a point inside GEOID 08001. Field names came from the proposal rather than from the generic role patterns, which matched none of them — no two counties name these fields alike, and that mapping is the whole reason this registry exists.

service.name: Adams County Parcels
service.notes: Four other parcel-ish layers are published (Unincorporated_Parcels, Tax_Authority_Parcels_Lot_by_Lot, Development_Parcels_WFL1, Parcel_Linework) and were not chosen. PARCELNB is the key the assessor tables join on.

51095.publisher: property.jamescitycountyva.gov (the county's own ArcGIS Server, not ArcGIS Online)
51095.review_notes: Discovery (AGOL search) found only a William & Mary lab and a developer mirror and proposed nothing; the county publishes on its own server, found by probing property.jamescitycountyva.gov/arcgis after CivQuest linked there. Every layer below was queried against parcel 6010200001 on 2026-09-15 and returned attributes consistent with the assessor page and the example deck (zoning M2; 1 story built 2023; legal 34.5369 ac). `GIS_Data` layer 72 carries the assessor's parcel record (owner, year built, finished size, sales, values) as a spatial layer, so it serves assessment, improvements and sales at once, joined on PIN.
